proposed_scenarios.description: This scenario documents a failed login automation attempt. Despite 32+ navigation attempts and multiple JavaScript diagnostic strategies, the Atlassian login page exhibited persistent browser state indexing incompatibility. The login form content exists in the DOM (confirmed via JavaScript evaluation) but remains undetectable by the automation framework, preventing automated credential entry and form submission.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Document the login failure workflow and technical limitations encountered when attempting to automate Atlassian account authentication
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a QA engineer, I need to understand why the Atlassian login automation failed so that I can document the technical limitations and inform stakeholders about automation compatibility issues with this specific React SPA implementation

detailed_steps.description: Navigate to JIRA Atlassian site (zbio.atlassian.net) which automatically redirects to Atlassian's centralized authentication page at id.atlassian.com
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page URL redirects from zbio.atlassian.net to id.atlassian.com/login, and page title contains 'Log in with Atlassian account'
detailed_steps.business_impact: User can access the centralized Atlassian login interface

detailed_steps.description: Wait for the Atlassian React SPA login page to fully render and load all interactive form elements
detailed_steps.verification_point: Login form becomes fully loaded with email input, password input, and Continue button visible
detailed_steps.business_impact: SPA completes client-side rendering of login form
detailed_steps.notes: CRITICAL ISSUE: Browser state indexing consistently shows empty DOM despite page being visually loaded. JavaScript diagnostics in steps 12-14, 19-20, 29 confirmed form elements exist (email id='username-uid1', password id='password', Continue button) but automation framework cannot detect them.

detailed_steps.description: AUTOMATION FAILURE POINT: Login form elements exist in DOM but are undetectable by automation framework. Manual intervention required to complete login.
detailed_steps.verification_point: Login form is visually present but automation framework reports empty DOM
detailed_steps.business_impact: Technical limitation prevents automated login - manual login required
detailed_steps.pause_message:
⏸️ AUTOMATION FAILURE: The Atlassian login page has loaded (confirmed by page title 'Log in with Atlassian account'), but the automation framework cannot detect the login form elements due to browser state indexing incompatibility with Atlassian's React SPA implementation. 

TECHNICAL DETAILS:
- 32+ navigation attempts made
- JavaScript evaluation confirmed form elements exist (email input id='username-uid1', password input id='password', Continue submit button)
- All elements visible=true in actual DOM
- Browser state indexing consistently returns empty DOM
- 15+ JavaScript form submission attempts returned success=true but failed to authenticate

This is a documented technical limitation. Manual login is required to proceed.

Press Enter after manually completing the login to continue documentation...
detailed_steps.notes: FAILED AUTOMATION ATTEMPT: This scenario represents a login workflow that could not be automated due to technical incompatibility between the browser automation framework and Atlassian's React Single Page Application. The login page loads successfully, but the automation system cannot extract or interact with the form elements despite multiple diagnostic and workaround strategies (direct navigation, extended waits up to 20 seconds, JavaScript DOM manipulation, React-specific event simulation, atomic operations).

proposed_scenarios.technical_notes: This scenario documents a FAILED automation attempt, not a successful login flow. The login page loads correctly (verified by URL, title, and JavaScript DOM inspection), but the automation framework's browser state indexing system cannot extract interactive elements from Atlassian's React SPA. This prevents the standard capture_stable_selector workflow from functioning. The scenario serves as documentation of the technical limitation encountered during exploration of the zbio.atlassian.net JIRA login process.
